papers_and_official_implementations.name: MM-GTUNets
papers_and_official_implementations.review: RFE imaging representation, phenotype VAE, dual 16-dimensional GTUNets, multimodal attention and classifier. Local server source takes precedence.

papers_and_official_implementations.name: RTGMFF
papers_and_official_implementations.review: The model applies age/gender FiLM to the visual representation after its local/global feature fusion. It standardizes age from the current ages tensor and directly applies gamma*h+beta; the paper does not provide an independent FiLM ablation.

papers_and_official_implementations.name: FiLM
papers_and_official_implementations.review: Feature-wise affine conditioning is established; the PEIM claim is limited to disease-task interaction evidence and selective modulation.

model/mm_gtunets.py: VAE reparameterization calls randn_like on every forward, including eval.
Multimodal attention constructs scores with torch.tensor, detaching score-derived modality weights.
Graph loss uses raw image/phenotype embeddings and attention-derived modality weights; changing attention image input may indirectly change graph loss.
model/gtunet.py: F.dropout is called without a training argument, so it remains active in eval.
model/rp_graph.py: The population-graph function returns from inside its score loop, preserving first-score behavior.
data_protocol: The cohort is 871-node transductive ABIDE with ASD label 0 (403) and TD label 1 (468).
RFE is historically cross-fold supervised; this experiment preserves the registered historical inputs and does not claim leakage-free external generalization.
RP attention weights have special state handling outside the ordinary model state dictionary.

historical_mechanism_review.M3: D4 image prototype CE plus phenotype prototype CE and image-teacher to phenotype-student probability KL. The phenotype branch remained near chance and teacher/student agreement was near 0.5; nonzero gradients did not establish semantic transfer.
historical_mechanism_review.PCCI: A constant condition-independent residual already damaged classification (C1); age/sex residual (C3) and shuffled residual (C6) were similarly weak, implicating generic feature disturbance rather than reliable individual phenotype signal.
historical_mechanism_review.experiment_24: The remote TPSSA report is NO_GO_STAGE_A with 0/40 formal tasks; site-controlled age/sex added weak training-internal prediction of image representation, so it stopped before training.
historical_mechanism_review.experiment_25: F3 learned nonzero FiLM modulation (about 2.53% feature-relative L2), yet versus M3 ACC fell about 0.573 pp and ASD sensitivity fell about 1.488 pp. F3-F4 AUC gain was about 0.588 pp, with fold2 contributing +5.461 pp; excluding fold2 left about +0.047 pp mean AUC change.
historical_mechanism_review.PEIM_question: Estimate phenotype-by-image disease interaction after removing image, phenotype and site main effects, compare to ordinary disease directions, then gate the same low-rank modulation by train-reference prototype-distance ambiguity.
